skills.name: Ichor Eos
skills.description: Pierces enemies with a spear transformed into Four-Blooded Spear of Fate, Ichor Desmos. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *Cancels enemy buffs   *ATK per sec x 1000% Area Damage (10 sec)

skills.name: Bond of Brothers
skills.description: Swears victory for his younger brother Poseidon, King of the Seas. Good effects on allies.  *Hit Rate +50%  (10 sec) *ATK Speed +230% (10 sec) *ATK +350% (10 sec)

abilities.name: Group: RoR III
abilities.description: RoR III Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy: Assassination+
abilities.description: Has a high chance of making a Reaper appear, killing 1 enemy Ranger instantly when Rangers deploy. - Activates only in PVP and Guild Battles.  - Activates 5 seconds after battles start.  - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected.
